overview.description: The T. Rowe Price Emerging Markets Equity Research ETF (TEMR) is an exchange-traded fund. The fund's investment portfolio concentrates primarily on total market equity. TEMR is actively managed, investing in equity securities of companies from emerging market countries, selected using a bottom-up stock selection approach. TEMR was launched on Mar 11, 2026 and is issued by T. Rowe Price.
